cc:Work.dc:title: communication-study-random-averages
cc:Work.dc:description: Four possible realizations of a random-phase cosine illustrate ensemble averaging at one fixed instant and time averaging along one realization. The four phases are selected for illustration, not independent measurement data or an exact finite-sample ensemble estimator.
